title: Figure 1: Energy Levels of a Metal and a Semiconductor
description: Schematic comparing electron energy levels in a metal and a semiconductor along an "Increasing Energy" axis, with electrons drawn as circled "e-" symbols. The metal side shows electrons moving freely into the "Conduction Band," while the semiconductor side labels a "Valence Band," "Band Gap" and "Conduction Band" with an electron arrow jumping the gap. The caption explains that semiconductors require more energy to excite electrons across the band gap; the page introduces quantum dots in a programmable-matter paper marked UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY.
